what: Team guide for the real arms through the Jetson: join the travel router, get SSH access, run the demo with one command (DreamSim/station.sh demo), and the rules every agent follows. AGENTS.md points agents to it.
why: The arms now run only through Dream's station on the Jetson; teammates and their agents need one way in and the same safety rules.
details: Jetson reachable as orin-arm.local over mDNS on the travel router (192.168.8.136, not reserved); host key fingerprint checked by name.

station.sh demo: starts the station if needed, 3 s countdown, runs Saleh's prompt with progress, then stop and home after 120 s or Ctrl-C. Non-motion paths tested (status, unreachable host, request body).
install-gs_usb.sh verified to download, hash-check and build from scratch on the Jetson.
No passwords, Wi-Fi key or Dream key in the repo; teammates send FADI their public key.
